play_equipment.evidence: A round dark disc with a lighter rim sits just south of the house near the lower edge of the outline, which could be a trampoline, but tree shadow makes it uncertain.

signals.notes: The house has a dark gray multi-gable roof and an asphalt driveway to the north. Dense mature trees on the east and south sides hide much of the yard, and a possible round trampoline sits at the south edge of the lot.
